name: Strategic-memory neutral prompts
description: Prompt requests that encourage independent planning and compact strategic memory without explicitly preferring decision support.
rationale: Rationale: <=2 sentences. State the immediate objective, coordination reason, or mandatory rule behind the action; do not restate the whole prompt.
action: Action: choose one of wait, move, broadcast. Follow mandatory rules and any Special directive if present.
action_move: Direction: choose ONLY from Legal moves. Prefer moves that support your own plan, memory, and teammate coordination.
action_broadcast: Message: If broadcast, send only the information teammates need now. On Drone 1 round 1, send the required JSON coverage plan.
memory_update: Memory: Store only future-use strategy and commitments using tags ROLE:, PLAN:, TEAM:, RV:, FIG:, POSSIBLE:, AVOID:, TRIGGER:, NOTE:, VISITED:. Do NOT copy Decision Support, Legal moves, or current prompt facts.
